upheld.title: Implementation Notes name the old email claim
upheld.detail: The Decisions bullet says the page reads the `email` claim. Commit 0868705 changed the code to read `ClaimTypes.Email` first, because the OIDC inbound claim map renames `email`, and to fall back to `email`. The notes no longer describe the code.
upheld.requirement: Pipeline rule: the story's `## Implementation Notes` (Decisions, Code map) must describe the code the PR implements.
